game.title: Tile Kingdoms
game.subtitle: Lay tiles, match edges, and claim the roads, keeps and shrines as your own.
board.name: Kingdom Table
deck.bag.name: Tile Bag
grid.square.name: Square Grid
tile.start-capital.name: Throne City
tile.start-capital.desc: The one marked tile; fixed on the centre cell to open the table.
tile.city-gate.name: Gate Keep
tile.city-gate.desc: One rampart edge; a small pennanted tower holds its centre.
tile.city-corner-keep.name: Corner Bastion
tile.city-corner-keep.desc: Walls on two adjacent edges with a pennanted bastion in the middle.
tile.city-wall-straight.name: Straight Ramparts
tile.city-wall-straight.desc: Unbroken walls run north to south around a small hold.
tile.city-corner-field.name: Open Corner
tile.city-corner-field.desc: Two walled edges shelter a bare, workable meadow centre.
tile.city-fortress.name: Great Keep
tile.city-fortress.desc: Walled on three sides; its two-flag keep pays a +2 bonus.
tile.city-crossroad.name: Wall Crossway
tile.city-crossroad.desc: Wall meets road at an open crossing centre.
tile.city-farm.name: Rampart Farm
tile.city-farm.desc: A farm under one wall edge, sharing the tile with the meadow.
tile.road-outpost.name: Road Post
tile.road-outpost.desc: A single road stub watched over by its centre post.
tile.road-straight.name: Straight Road
tile.road-straight.desc: A trade road running straight north to south.
tile.road-bend.name: Bending Road
tile.road-bend.desc: A road turning the corner between two adjacent edges.
tile.road-crossing.name: Crossroads
tile.road-crossing.desc: Roads meet on all four edges around a busy square.
tile.road-junction.name: Three Ways
tile.road-junction.desc: A three-armed junction crowning the centre.
tile.road-village.name: Roadside Village
tile.road-village.desc: A village set on a straight road, ready for a watchman.
tile.road-shrine.name: Shrine Terminus
tile.road-shrine.desc: The road ends at a chapel door in the heart of this tile.
tile.shrine-field.name: Field Shrine
tile.shrine-field.desc: A chapel ringed by meadows; nine points once all eight neighbours land.
tile.shrine-crossroad.name: Pilgrims' Crossway
tile.shrine-crossroad.desc: A sacred border crosses a road beside the centre shrine.
tile.shrine-border.name: Sacred Border
tile.shrine-border.desc: One blessed march edge around a small shrine.
tile.shrine-corner.name: Sacred Corner
tile.shrine-corner.desc: Sacred marches meet at a bare corner.
tile.shrine-wall.name: Shrine Wall
tile.shrine-wall.desc: A sacred march runs through, guarded by its shrine.
tile.open-field.name: Open Meadow
tile.open-field.desc: Meadow on all four sides; empty ground for farmers.
tile.field-farm.name: Wheat Field
tile.field-farm.desc: All meadow, with a wheat-headed field at its heart.
tile.field-pasture.name: Green Pasture
tile.field-pasture.desc: All meadow, with trees and a small herd at its centre.
tile.city-sprawltown.name: Suburb Street
tile.city-sprawltown.desc: Wall on one edge, road on another; a suburb joins the two.
worker.scout.name: Watchman
worker.scout.use: Stands on a road; reaps 1 point per tile when that road closes.
worker.guard.name: Guard
worker.guard.use: Stands in a city; takes 2 points per tile plus pennant bonuses when it closes.
worker.monk.name: Monk
worker.monk.use: Stands at a shrine; claims 9 points once all eight neighbours land.
worker.farmer.name: Farmer
worker.farmer.use: Stays in the field; his harvest is only counted at the end.

rule.turn: On your turn: draw a tile, lay it, optionally place one worker, score what you closed.
rule.draw: Draw one tile from the bag and keep its face to yourself.
rule.place: The new tile must touch the map along at least one edge; never leave a gap.
rule.edge-match: Facing edges must carry the same kind: city to city, road to road, shrine to shrine, field to field.
rule.fallback: If the tile fits nowhere, return it to the bag and pass without a worker.
rule.worker: Place a worker on the new tile's feature: Watchman on road, Guard in city, Monk at shrine, Farmer in field.
rule.majority: The player with the most workers on a closed feature scores it; ties share the score.
rule.road-score: A completed road scores 1 point per tile.
rule.city-score: A completed city scores 2 points per tile; each pennant +2, the Great Keep +2.
rule.shrine-score: A shrine ringed by its eight neighbours scores 9 points in total.
rule.field-score: Fields score only at the end: each farmer earns 3 points per completed city it touches.
rule.end: When the bag runs dry the last round is played; unfinished work scores short.
rule.first-tile: The Throne City opens the game, face up, dead centre of the table.
